sections.title: Everything from this unit, in one description
sections.content: napirend ("daily routine", literally "day-order") is the word for everything you've been describing across this unit. A full description just chains what you already know: a routine verb, a -kor time, a sequencing word, a day with -on/-en/-ön, and a -tól/-ig span, one after another.

items.spanish: Hétköznap ez a napirendem: hét órakor felkelek, kilenctől ötig dolgozom, este pihenek.
items.english: On weekdays this is my routine: I get up at seven, I work from nine to five, in the evening I rest.

items.spanish: Hétvégén fáradt vagyok, ezért sokáig alszom.
items.english: On the weekend I'm tired, so I sleep late (for a long time).

sections.content: pihen ("to rest") and fáradt ("tired") are a natural pair — fáradt vagyok, ezért pihenek ("I'm tired, so I rest") reuses the mert/ezért reasoning pattern you already know from A1, just with new vocabulary to reason about.
